The modifications in the file are interrelated as they collectively address the issue of handling arbitrary image widths in the `sys_imageblit()` function. The introduction of the `shift` variable and the adjustment of loop conditions ensure that both fully filled and partially filled pixel data are processed correctly. The new loop for trailing pixels directly builds upon the changes made in the main pixel processing logic, ensuring that performance improvements from a previous commit are maintained while fixing the bug related to unaligned image widths.
